description: This file defines the 'GatewayDiscoveryModel' class responsible for discovering, managing, and resolving gateways in a network. It includes data structures for gateway identities and details, methods for starting/stopping discovery, mapping beacons to gateway objects, deduplicating entries, resolving network services, and handling internal states and background tasks related to network discovery using mDNS/Bonjour DNS-SD.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class responsible for device gateway discovery, management, and resolution using network browsing and beacons.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Encapsulates the resolved details (TXT records, host, port) for a network service.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Handles resolution of network services via NetService, including DNS TXT record fetch and address resolution.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins network discovery for gateways across specified domains.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing discovery activities, cancels tasks and clears caches.

methods.name: refreshWideAreaFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs immediate wide-area service discovery, updating internal list of gateways.

methods.name: refreshTailscaleServeFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs immediate Tailscale Serve gateway discovery.

methods.name: refreshRemoteFallbackNow
methods.description: Triggers both wide area and Tailscale fallback discoveries simultaneously.

methods.name: mapWideAreaBeacons
methods.description: Maps wide-area beacon data into DiscoveredGateway objects.

methods.name: mapTailscaleServeBeacons
methods.description: Maps Tailscale Serve beacons into DiscoveredGateway objects.

methods.name: recomputeGateways
methods.description: Aggregates and filters the list of discovered gateways, deduplicating and prioritizing them.

methods.name: updateGateways
methods.description: Updates the internal list of gateways for a specific domain based on the latest results.

methods.name: ensureServiceResolution
methods.description: Initiates resolution of a service to determine its address and TXT records when needed.
